title: NHC-smp
description: Hermitcraft inspired SMP. We at NHC have loads of fun with events, builds, pranks, and more! Apply to play today!
body:
# Welcome to NotHermitcraft!

**NotHermitcraft (NHC)** is a community-driven **Vanilla SMP** and we're recruiting new members for our **newly started Season 5**!

NHC has been around since **2019** and has grown into a friendly community of many different playstyles — **redstoners, builders, role-players, explorers, and more.**

Our community includes players **ages 14–50+** from all over the world including **the USA, Canada, Australia, Asia, and Europe**.

We also have an **active Discord server** with a bot that allows players to **chat between Discord and the Minecraft server**.

---

# New Season (Season 5)

We have just launched **Season 5**, with a focus on keeping players **close together and connected** to recreate the true **Hermitcraft-style experience**.

Season 5 is planned to last **2–3 years**, giving everyone plenty of time to build, collaborate, and make their mark on the world.

---

# Season 4ever

Our previous world has been running for **over 3 years** and is called **Season 4ever** — and it's named that for a reason!

Even though Season 5 has begun, **Season 4ever remains available as a sub-server**.

Want to explore our history or continue building in the previous world?  
You can **visit it anytime**.

---

# Mod packs!

We have two mod packs built just for our SMP. 

1) We have a more [Basic Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/nhc) made for the NotHermitCraft server. A client-side Fabric modpack for Minecraft. Includes all server-side supported mods. Subtle tweaks and various minor improvements.
Gives extra functionality during events. An easy way for people to join the server(s) with mods.


2) [NHC PLUS!](https://modrinth.com/modpack/nhc-plus) The same as above with even more mods! QOL, animations, tools, and more. 


pick which one you like more!

---

# Discord & Community Events

You can find the **application form** in our Discord server.

Join us here:  
**https://nhc-smp.com/**

In addition to our regular SMP gameplay, we host **community events** such as:

- Last Life
- UHC
- Movie Nights
- Party Games
- Other community events

# Rules

- Keep swearing to an absolute minimum.
- Be respectful and kind to each other.
- No griefing, hacking, x-raying, duping, or exploiting glitches.
- No adult content or discussions (younger players are part of the community).

---

Come join us and be part of the **NotHermitcraft community!**
